principle: Preserve every authorized front as a distinct, recoverable contributor; braid shared evidence without collapsing independence or manufacturing agreement.

front_identity.rule: A front may be dormant or HELD without being discarded.

golden_thread.meaning: Source-bound lineage from Seed through Path, experiment, challenge, receipt, projection and recovery.
golden_thread.rule: No ungrounded PASS, orphaned claims, or silent clobber.

rules: All front-to-front links are typed and attributable.
A merge creates a new versioned artifact with explicit parents; it does not erase source branches.
Contradictions remain visible until independently adjudicated.
Permission and consent checks precede cross-front sharing.
Each front can replay its own history without relying on a single conversational memory.
Cross-front signals are candidate inputs, not automatic authority.
braid.anti_capture: No one front, including the public-facing Orb, may silently become the only custodian or decision maker.

fray.behavior: Expose HOLD/FAILED with cause and next trigger, preserve last known good, and avoid claiming a complete braid.

continuity.one_seed: One discoverable entry pointer per bounded wave, referencing many immutable sources.
continuity.one_orb: One coherent user-facing projection with text-first fallback.
continuity.one_gauge: One evidence-linked composite status, with underlying metrics and blockers exposed.
continuity.one_thumb: One safe reversible next action or explicit no-action state.
continuity.one_time: UTC receipt time plus source and observation times.
continuity.durability: >24h independent readback is an acceptance test, not an observed fact.
continuity.handoff: Independent consumer must fetch, verify and receipt a front head before ACK.

wave_diversity: Vary hypotheses, audiences, scales, substrates and challenge methods; preserve identical replication trials when scientifically useful.
tests: Two independent fronts ingest the same verified Seed and preserve distinct IDs.
A challenge remains visible after merge, with source evidence.
An orphaned source produces CoFray HOLD rather than false PASS.
A public Orb node can be traced to an immutable source and its permission.
An independent process reconstructs the braid after >24h.
A denied private edge never appears in public projections.
next: Build a machine-checkable braid manifest and a second independent reader that emits receipts; do not claim running cross-session federation until tested.
proof_boundary: Publishing this draft does not prove cross-front synchronization, persistent workers, 24-hour survival, independent handoff, public website deployment, or universal source recovery.
